title: Global Configuration
desc: The UI kit ships with a lightweight global configuration layer. Register it once at the app root with createUiKit() to set a BEM namespace and per-component default props for the whole app.

create-ui-kit.title: createUiKit()
create-ui-kit.desc: Creates a Vue plugin that provides the global config down the component tree via app.provide(). Install it before mounting the app; provided options are merged over the base config (namespace: 'd'). The example below reproduces the same effect with a local provide().

namespace.title: namespace
namespace.desc: A string prefix prepended to every generated BEM class. Defaults to d. Use it to scope the UI kit styles under your own prefix and avoid collisions.

components.title: components.button
components.desc: Per-component default props. Any prop left undefined by the component instance falls back to these values. Currently button is the only supported key.

priority.title: Resolution order
priority.desc: Every prop is resolved as 1) local prop, 2) global config, 3) component default — the first non-empty value wins. The global config is scope-based: providing a new one inside a subtree overrides the outer one for that subtree.
